comparison.objective: Carry a long thin panel bimanually and place it on rack rails without excessive bow.
comparison.physical_skill: Distributed two-hand support, coordinated transport, and low-deflection placement.
comparison.success_condition: Panel rests on the destination rack within pose and bow limits after release.
comparison.reason: Shared long-object bimanual support is generic. This record tests flex control during transport; the candidate tests rigid articulated-rail orientation, spring-prong latching, extension, cross-post leveling, and screws.
